description_en: Open with a startling visual or claim
description_zh: then immediately ask a question that flips it back on the viewer ("你有没有过这种感觉...")
common_in: 用一个让人愣住的画面或断言开头
column7: 马上反问把问题扔给观众

description_en: First 3 seconds describe a pain so specific the viewer thinks "this is literally me" ("月薪 1 万的打工人
common_in: 前 3 秒精准描述一种痛感
column7: 精准到观众觉得"说的就是我"

description_en: Hook opens with "X 秒讲清楚 Y" or "1 分钟搞定 Z" promising compressed value
description_zh: 开头"X 秒讲清楚 Y" 或 "1 分钟搞定 Z" 承诺压缩价值

description_en: Side-by-side or quick cut from "before" terrible state to "after" outcome — visual proof of transformation
common_in: 从"之前"惨状到"之后"成果

description_en: Open with a statement that contradicts popular belief ("其实减肥不靠运动" or "为什么我不再读这种书")
description_zh: 开头一句违反大众认知 ("其实减肥不靠运动" / "为什么我不再读这种书")

description_en: X 个 Y hook — promises a finite enumerable payload ("5 个让你提前退休的副业")
description_zh: X 个 Y 钩子 — 承诺有限可枚举内容

description_en: Opens with a teaser of the dramatic moment in a personal story then rewinds to "let me tell you how I got here"
description_zh: 开头先抛故事最戏剧的画面
common_in: 然后倒叙"我跟你讲我怎么到这一步的"

description_en: Lead with a credential or visible authority cue (在 [大公司] 工作 10 年 / 哈佛/清华学姐 / 1 万粉积累的经验)
description_zh: 开头亮资历或可见权威信号 (大公司 10 年 / 名校 / 1 万粉经验)

description_en: Show a lifestyle/result viewer wishes they had + nail it as actually attainable not aspirational ("这是我 24 岁就买房的真实流水")
description_zh: 展示观众羡慕的生活/结果
common_in: 并暗示其实可达成而非遥不可及

description_en: I let AI [do thing] for me / "X 工具我用了 30 天
common_in: AI 给我[做事]/我用 X 工具 30 天/AI 一键搞定 — 工具神化叙事

description_en: Open with a quiet personal confession that builds intimacy ("最近一直没敢告诉妈妈...")
description_zh: 开头一句私密自白建立亲密 ("最近一直没敢告诉妈妈...")

description_en: Take a deliberately polarizing stance designed to invite comment-section debate ("月薪 3 万还在 996 是该跳槽")
description_zh: 刻意取一个会引战的立场
common_in: 设计成评论区开战 ("月薪 3 万还在 996 是该跳槽")
